description: Migrate the 86 top-level src/pages/*.tsx (mostly DataTable CRUD pages, ~168 raw buttons, 16 raw selects, emoji in Reports, Meetings, WorkRecords, CompensatoryLeave) onto PageContainer, PageHeader, Card, EmptyState, Button/IconButton/ButtonLink and ui/Select, with the same pattern as FEAT-002.
steps: Mechanical pass over all top-level pages: wrapper -> PageContainer, title block -> PageHeader (CreateButton etc. go into PageHeader actions), card boxes -> Card/CardHeader/CardContent, inline empty text -> EmptyState, raw buttons/links -> Button/IconButton/ButtonLink, raw select (CompensatoryLeave, HourAccount, others) -> ui/Select, emoji -> Iconify, palette/hex -> tokens. A small codemod script may be used for the wrapper/title swap but every file must be reviewed and compiled; delete the script afterwards (not committed).

Pages with their own bespoke layouts (Reports, Meetings, Policies, HRSettings, Fleet, Staffing, Profile, Compliance, HourAccount, WorkRecords, Login if inside the scope) get the same shared pieces; Login stays outside AppShell and only has its buttons migrated.
acceptance_criteria: Every top-level page renders content at the same x/y offset (PageContainer) with a PageHeader
0 raw <button>/<select>, 0 emoji icons and no palette/hex in src/pages/*.tsx outside documented exceptions
verification: npx tsc -b 2>&1 | grep -c 'error TS'  -> <=131 and no error in files this FEAT touched that was not there before
findings:
Verified on branch minimal-ui-pass2: tsc 125 errors (<=131; 0 new vs FEAT-002 baseline, compared by error text), oxlint 230 warnings (<=294), vitest 19 pass, vite build ok, full playwright 34 pass (incl. primitives), grep '<button|<select' over src/pages/*.tsx = 0 lines.
All 86 top-level pages: CRUD pages use PageContainer+PageHeader (actions in PageHeader), bespoke pages (Reports, Meetings, Policies, Profile, Compliance, HourAccount, WorkRecords, CompensatoryLeave, DocumentRequests, EmployeeBonusPoints, HRSettings, Gratuity, LossOfPay, Shifts, HolidayLists detail) use PageContainer/PageHeader/Card/StateView/StatCard/Tabs/Iconify/Button/IconButton/ButtonLink. Tab strips (Recruitment, TaxBenefits, OnboardingTemplates, AttendanceRequests, ShiftRequests, Shifts, CompensatoryLeave) now use ui/Tabs (role=tab/aria-selected; Recruitment lost aria-current=page, Shifts nav tabs gained role=tab). Card = ui/Card with p-N classes kept on Card.
Files without PageContainer/PageHeader (justified): one-line wrappers rendering a subdir page (Appraisals, Attendance, Employees, Expenses, Grievances, Leaves, Overtime, Payroll, Settlements, Travel, Training), Login and AuthCallback (outside AppShell, spinner only, no buttons).
Behaviour notes (no functional change): raw buttons became Button/IconButton with the same onClick/disabled/aria; aria-label taken from former title/text (new labels where none existed: Close, Delete comment, Remove leave type, Clear search, Previous/Next year, Close filters, Clear filters, Remove filter); type=button dropped (Button default), submit kept. CompensatoryLeave comments view lost its duplicate '> Comments' text button (Back to Requests remains). Employee Bonus Points active-filter chip is a plain span with IconButton instead of a Card. DocumentRequests and AttendanceRegister KPI tiles now StatCard (no per-status tinting). Branches table render '⭐ Yes' is now 'Yes'. Reports and Meetings emoji replaced by Iconify registry names (attendance, leaves, payroll, chart, kras, employees, holidayLists, expenses, user, policies, leaveBlock, feedback, geoLocations, healthInsurance, expenseTaxes, bonusPoints).
Grep exceptions: no raw hex or Tailwind palette classes in src/pages/*.tsx. Remaining non-icon glyphs are text separators (bullet, middle dot, en/em dash), password mask dots in HRSettings placeholder, currency symbols. Bordered inset panels/alerts (error/success banners, tinted info boxes, form fieldsets in modals, absolute dropdown popovers) were intentionally left as plain token divs since there is no Alert/Popover primitive yet. Raw <input>/<textarea> in HourAccount, Policies, DocumentRequests, Meetings remain (not in scope).
Pre-existing tsc errors still present in touched files (unused vars etc., in baseline): CompensatoryLeave canDelete, Meetings, WorkRecords, HourAccount syncMutation.
For later steps: Iconify registry names are camelCase nav names plus generic names; no new icons were added in FEAT-003.
